item.title: Feature: What I Learned After Working On Over 1,000 Switch 2 Joy-Con

description.p: The joys and cons.Coming into this console generation with the spectre of Switch 1's Joy-Con drift debacle in our minds, reviewers approached the Switch 2's Joy-Con with extreme caution. The controllers seemed much improved, but problems take time to manifest, and even when things do go wrong, knowing whether you've got a one-off dud or a widespread issue is difficult.With that in mind, we invited Gal Silver of GameTraderZero to share his thoughts, having disassembled and worked on hundreds of Joy-Con 2s in the 15 months since we first got our hands on them...Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo Wins Court Case Ruling The Sale Of Switch "Circumvention Devices" Unlawful

description.p: "avoid purchasing or using circumvention devices".Nintendo is celebrating a court case victory in the Netherlands that says the sale of "devices designed to circumvent Nintendo’s security measures" is unlawful.Specifically referencing cards such as the MIG Switch Card, the case heard at The Hague District Court (Rechtbank Den Haag) involved a complaint against an online seller 'dropshipping' the devices from Asia. These devices can be used to play pirated copies of games and unofficial software on modified Switch hardware.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
